title: EnvironmentInfo
description: State of the two external facilities the application cannot work without: the git command line and a place to keep secrets. Returned by the environment.describe JSON-RPC method so the renderer can block or warn honestly rather than failing later.

gitAvailable.description: True when a usable git executable was found on PATH. The application is non-functional when this is false.

gitVersion.description: Version string reported by git --version, present only when gitAvailable is true.

secretBackend.description: Which store is actually protecting the master key that encrypts API keys. Reported so the interface can state the real guarantee rather than an assumed one.

secretBackendIsFallback.description: True when the platform's credential store was unavailable and the machine-derived fallback engaged. The interface warns when this is set.
